items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: But I know George Field is one of them good bands.

ctx.x: Was it a dance band or a brass band he was doing?

He was playing brass band, and jazz band too. I think George was playing with only Robichaud I think. No, but I know what Vic Gasco, but Robichaud Trombone player. But I know George Field is one of them good bands.
